short: The Magi who visit the infant Jesus.
note: The eastern visitors in Matthew 2 who follow a star and bring gold, frankincense, and myrrh to Jesus. The Gospel names three gifts but gives neither the visitors’ number nor their names.
An old woman of Italian folklore who travels on a broom and fills children’s stockings with sweets or coal on the night of January 5–6, the eve of Epiphany.
